title: Largest density of a layered subgraph of a hypercube
summary: Let $L(t)$ denote the largest number of edges induced by $t$ vertices from two vertex layers of a hypercube. We show that $$\frac14 t\log_2 t+\frac18 t\log_2\log_2 t-O(t) \leq L(t) \leq \frac14 t\log_2 t+ (1+o(1))t\log_2\log_2 t.$$
